Chapter 287: Chapter 2 Chikun Star Lord: Good disciple, your question is a bit beyond the scope… (Please subscribe)

“Judgment complete?”

A smile spread across Lin Yuan’s face.

Each time he returned, he immediately uploaded the subsequent chapters of the newly pioneered Martial Tao Evolution Path to the Goddess of Wisdom.

Aside from receiving a bounty of Merit Points and better dissemination of the Martial Tao Evolution Path,

it was to take advantage of the Goddess of Wisdom’s immense computational power to see the potential of the submitted chapters.

The potential of an Evolution Path involves various aspects and is very difficult to estimate; even the Goddess of Wisdom and the other two goddesses can only deduce it approximately.

...

But that was enough.

Among the vast ocean of Evolution Paths collected by the Cosmic Human Alliance, the final judgments made by the Goddess of Wisdom and the other two goddesses still carry significant reference value.

In simple terms,

if the Goddess of Wisdom judges the potential of an Evolution Path to be low, it might not be accurate,

but if the Goddess of Wisdom determines the potential of an Evolution Path to be high, it is certainly not far off.

“Respected Sixth-Level Citizen Lin Yuan, based on the final judgment, the Martial Tao Evolution Path Sixth Tier Chapter you uploaded is valued at four hundred thousand Merit Points…”

…

“Four hundred thousand Merit Points?”

Lin Yuan was quite satisfied in his heart.

The last ‘update’ of the Martial Tao Evolution Path, which involved a comprehensive re-upload after perfecting the Second Layer Chapter, Third Tier Chapter, Fourth Rank Chapter, and Fifth Stage Section, had garnered a reward of only five hundred thousand Merit Points.

This time, just for uploading the Sixth Tier Chapter, the value reached four hundred thousand Merit Points, which was already very high.

One must know, four hundred thousand Merit Points were equivalent to the value of slaying almost half an Eighth Layer Alien Strong One.

On the battlefields of different races, killing an Eighth Rank Alien Strong Ones usually yielded a Merit Point reward of only a million.

And were Eighth Layer Alien Strong Ones so easy to kill? Defeating one might be possible, but slaying one was as difficult as ascending to heaven.

Eighth Rank Alien Strong Ones are the foundation of the various races, and most have life-saving cards. The Chikun Star Lord who is as strong as they come struggles to kill an Eighth Rank Alien on the alien race battlefield.

And those Eighth Rank Alien Strong Ones are not fools, they will definitely flee if they find themselves unable to win.

“To go from a Sixth-Level Citizen to a Seventh-Level Citizen… requires two million Merit Points…”

Lin Yuan glanced at the Merit Point requirement for the next citizen level upgrade and shook his head.

Two million Merit Points… it was an astronomical figure; not just for other Evolvers, even Lin Yuan felt a tingling in his scalp.

A typical Seventh Rank Evolver might sit on the battlefield of different races for tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of years without being able to accumulate such a massive amount of Merit Points.

The battlefield of different species is extremely dangerous, with Human Race evolvers fighting alien strong ones, constantly at risk of losing their lives.

Although, Evolvers of the Sixth Rank and above have the right to Resurrection, if you don’t have potential, who would resurrect you?

Most Sixth Rank and Seventh Rank Evolvers, once dead, are truly dead.

“Forget it.”

Lin Yuan had no plans on becoming a Seventh-Level Citizen in the short term,

probably not until he could create the Martial Tao Evolution Path Seventh Stage before he could meet the requirement of becoming a Seventh-Level Citizen.

“Let’s see the latest evaluation of the Martial Arts Evolution System…”

Lin Yuan began to flip through the information related to the Martial Tao Evolution Path.

Every time the Goddess of Wisdom reassessed the Martial Tao Evolution Path, she would update Lin Yuan’s data first.

As for other citizens or Evolvers, they had to wait until the rankings update at dawn to see any ‘updated’ changes to the Martial Tao Evolution Path.

“The probability of advancing to the Seventh Rank is sixty percent…..”

“The probability of advancing to the Ninth Rank Evolution Path is twenty percent…”

…

“Not bad…”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly.

Before uploading the Sixth Rank Chapter, the probability of the Martial Tao Evolution Path advancing to the Seventh Rank was only thirty percent.

The probability of reaching the Ninth Rank was only ten percent.

Now, both have doubled.

Especially the fact that there is a twenty percent chance of advancing to the Eighth Rank… one must know, whether a new Eighth Rank Evolution Path is opened is a key judgement for the Cosmic Alliance of Human Civilizations in determining if one can become a great scholar of Evolution.

Now, the Martial Tao Evolution Path has a twenty percent chance of advancing to the Eighth Rank, its potential is extremely tremendous.

“The Ninth Stage Evolution Path…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts drifted; so far, the Martial Tao Evolution Path had no chance of advancing to the Ninth Rank.

“Now, where would the Martial Tao Evolution Path rank on the Chikun Evolution Rankings?”

Lin Yuan continued to view the updated Martial Tao Evolution Path, opening the rankings section.

“Ranked first on the Canglan Evolution Ranking…”

“Ranked sixth on the Chikun Evolution Rankings?”

…

“Sixth?”

Lin Yuan’s heart stirred.

After the last perfection of the Martial Tao Evolution Path, once it was no longer limited to Taiyin and Taiyang, it broke into the twelfth spot on the Chikun Evolution Rankings.

Now the uploaded Sixth Tier Chapter has directly broken into the sixth place.

One must know that the Evolution Paths in the top ten of the Chikun Evolution Rankings are all Seventh Rank Evolution Paths with hopes of ascending to the Eighth Rank.

And the top three Evolution Paths of the Chikun Evolution Rankings are all Eighth Rank Evolution Paths.

Over the hundreds of thousands to millions of years of Chikun Star Domain’s history, only three great scholars of Evolution have been born.

And these three Eighth Rank Evolution Paths have all come from the hands of these great scholars.

The number of great scholars is far rarer than that of Eighth Rank Evolvers.

…

Having seen the ranking of the Martial Tao Evolution Path,

Lin Yuan glanced at the approximate number of Evolvers currently practicing the Martial Tao Evolution Path.

“First Tier Chapter: Ninety-seven thousand three hundred twenty-three people.”

“Second Layer Chapter: Thirty-two thousand six hundred people.”

“Third Rank Chapter: One hundred and thirty-six people.”

“Fourth Rank Chapter: Zero people.”

…

“Not bad.”

“In just over a year, the number of Evolvers in the First Tier and Second Layer Chapters has grown two to three times…”

“And more than a hundred Evolvers have started practicing the Third Rank Chapter…”
